name: Work In Paradise Programme (Remote Worker Stay)

requirements.blocker_text: Must perform work for a foreign-based employer or business -- working for any company present in the BVI is prohibited under this programme.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources reviewed

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands -- 'Work In Paradise Programme To Be Launched' press release: Immigration Department-led remote-worker programme, no local BVI employment permitted, joint initiative with the Department of Labour and Workforce Development and the BVI Tourist Board and Film Commission

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the British Virgin Islands' initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- although the source is tier-1 (a government press release announcing the programme's launch), it is a launch announcement rather than an operational programme page: no application form, fee, duration, or eligible-nationality detail was located, and it is unclear from this pass whether the programme is issued as a visa category, an endorsement on the standard visitor entry, or an administrative designation similar to Aruba's One Happy Workation. Modelled as its own route since the government explicitly frames it as revenue-generating pandemic-recovery infrastructure distinct from ordinary tourism, with its own named eligibility rule (foreign employer only) -- but held at draft pending a dedicated application/policy page to confirm operational details and current status (the announcement dates to the COVID-19 recovery period; whether the programme is still active as of this pass was not independently reconfirmed).
